translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Meeta Kka e Oamonofitiir Aeremas
Jesus a aengaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe pwe, “Minikka e feoffeeori pwe aeremas repwe monofit ina epwe wewwen rhag, nge ifa mwo aenneewan ngaeni aeremas na efeeori minikkeei pwe epwe wen!
Efaer gacch ngaeni igine aere e geeogeeo tae efai fai temoag rhaepin iiuwan a aegekkaerh noa nee set me mmwaen aan feeori pwe erhai aet mwittig kaan epwe monofit.
Iwe oaw emwaeri meeta kkomwu oawgaen feeori! “Aere igine erhai pwiimw e monofit, soong ngaeni, aere e toagun saengi aan monofit, saeneti noa.
Aere igine e monofit ngaeniug faaen fisuuw noan eraaen, nge a gaen itto aengaeniug pwe, ‘ngaang iya toagun saengi monofitiy,’ wopwe pwan saeneti noa.”
Niugiuniug
Oapostonus kkewe ra aengaeni Soamwoon pwe, “Oatomoga noa aemaem niugiuniug.”

Soamwoon a paniuwaeni pwe, “Aere aaemi niugiuniug eweei nepaen faiun mustard een, emmwen oawpwe aengaeni waniwan temoag een pwe, ‘Wisaegtae me waeroamw wa noa foat noa nee set!’ ina epwe rongorong ngaeniug.
Aaen Erhai Rhooan Akkiuneo Engaang
“Aere erhai noawumw rhooan akkiuneo engaang fetaen noan maat aere e aefaenniy noawumw sheep, iwe nge enoa itto me noan maat, wopwe mmwenen aengaeni pwe aemwetekkaeiyiug pwe epwene mwongo?
Aapw aere! Wopwe faer aengaeni pwe, ‘Wonoa feeori aenaei mwongo, nge wa ngaettae mengaagiun oamw engaang nge wa itto ngoatto aenaei pwe ipwe mwongo nge i iun; inoa moann nge een wonaaen mwongo.’
Rhooan akkiuneo we mwo nge wosoapw ngaenneei aan aerhigerhig pwe iga e tapweei oamw akkiuneo, aere meeta?
Epwan ina rhag wusumi; oatona oawpwe oamoanna meeta oawpwe feeori, nge oawwa iura pwe, ‘Aemaem rhag rhooan akkiuneo; aeifeeori rhag engaang kka aemaem.’ ”
Jesus e Aecchipwa Seig Mwaaen
Igiwe Jesus a nennoa ngaeni Jerusalem, e faaeraeg wooan ayiuweyiuwen nepetaen Samaria me Galilee.
Oatowe a toonong noan eew pwugos, a rhuungiir seig mwaaen kaenepaai. Re iu rhag me itaaw,
nge ra aekkepwas, “Jesus! Soamwoon! Faayeogemaem!”
Jesus a weriir nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Oawnoa aengaeniir patere pwe repwe worigaemi.” Igiwe ra feffaaeraeg noa nge a rhiuw noa minikkewe kaenepaiiur.
Oatowe erhai me neeiir a weri pwe a cchipw noa miniwe ginin, iwe a sefaaen, nge a gaen igin oatomogatae aan aepingepinga Deus.
A itto aerheitiw oanongan reen pirheen Jesus a itto fang aan aerhigerhig. Mwaaen we nge erhai re Samaria.
Jesus a kkepas nge a iura pwe, “Nge aetae iwe seig rhooa kkewe e mwamwaai noa giniir; nge ifa ikkiwe tiweman?
Meeta faaen minne waseona een rhag minne e sefaaeneto pwe e itto fang aaen Deus aerhigerhig reen?”
Nge Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Iutae wa noa; pwe oamw niugiuniug a aetekkoagtae.”
Itton Minna Mweoiun Deus
Aekkaerhai Pharisees re aeiineow Jesus ineeta epwe itto minna Mweoiun Deus. Nge a paniuwaeni pwe, “Minna Mweoiun Deus ina esoapw itto nge noan taeppen we sipwe rhuungi.
Esooar ne epwe iura pwe, ‘Oaw pipiiy pwe ieei iiy!’ aere ‘Inaan iiy!’; pwe minna Mweoiun Deus ina a no neeimi.”
Iwe aengaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe, “Eyor oatokka oaw aeneaeneei pwe oawpwe weri eew minikkena raaenin mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas, nge oawsoapw weri.
Eyor manekka repwe aengaenigaemi pwe, ‘Fannoa iginaan!’ aere, ‘Fatto igaan!’ Nge aaemi oawsoapw toowow noa giutta fetaeneei.
Pwe igine epwene weriwer noan naaeng nge e aesserema noa noan naaeng, ina epwe pwan ina wusun mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas noan minna raaenin.
Nge mmwan, ina epwe igin affayeo me serhoawun me reer aeremesaen raaennekkeei.
Epwe pwan taeppen miniwe ewen mweoiun Noah, ina epwe pwan wen noan raaenin mini Naiun Aeremas.
Oanongeer aeremas re rhiuwen mwommwongo me kukkupwun, nge mwaaen me rhooapwut re pwiuppwiuniuw toori raaenin we Noah a teeotae rhiun pwoot we waan, iwe e itto rhag noataer we niir noa oanongeer.
Epwe pwan taeppen weni mweoiun Lot. Oanongeer aeremas nge re mwongo noa rhag me kkupwun noa rhag, nge re chuwaai fetaen, foato fetaen, me kaiu fetaen iimw.
Noan raaenin we Lot a nigiti Sodom, aengaet me sulfur a piungtiw me noan naaeng a ittiw niir noa oanongeer.
Epwe pwan ina wusun minne epwe wen noan raaenin na epwe pwaeto mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas.
“Noan raaenin naan nge iyo eno wooan wungaen iimw, esoapw teeotiw no nee iimw epwe pweipwog pisaegin; pwan ina rhag wusun iyo eno noan maat pwe esoapw pwan sefaaen noa nee iimw.
Oaw maengiy rhag niewe pwiuniuwaei Lot!
Iyo na e mwerhaen epwe ammwarhiu menewan ina epwe ppiung saengi; nge iyo na eppiung saengi menewan, ina epwe menaw.
Ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe noan pwongin naan riiurhai aeremas re maiur wooan eew pooa; erhai repwe pwigi noa nge erhai epwe notiw.
Riiurhai rhooapwut repwe ammaat mwongo; erhai repwe pwigi noa nge erhai epwe notiw.
[Igine riiurhai mwaaen repwe engaang noan maat nge erhai ra pwigi noa nge erhai a notiw.”]
Rhooan akkiuneo kkewe naiun ra aeiineow pwe, “Iya, Soamwoon?” Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ese tiwegin igine epwe yor erhai manimae ee, nge witiyas repwe mweoiuto reen.”
